walkthroughs.body_html:
Poor quality means returns, refunds and bad reviews.

Good quality keeps customers happy and protects the reputation. ⭐

Quality control — check items at the end of the line. Reject the bad ones.

Quality assurance — build quality in at every stage. Stop bad ones from being made in the first place.

Service is everything around the product:

  • Friendly staff.
  • Quick answers.
  • Fair returns.
  • Solving complaints quickly.

One bad experience can become a viral video. 📱
